title: 第七章 只为见一人，趁他昏迷疯狂揩油
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
傅烬川喉结滚了滚，恢复了一丝清醒，他急忙松开手，强撑着想要拉开距离，没想到又晕了过去。

    晕了？

    怕他出事，姜无念把衣服整个掀开到处检查，摸摸腹肌，摸摸腰，摸摸胸肌又摸摸手，嘴里嘟囔着：

    “小灵丹醒醒，我保证下次轻一点，你要是死了，我又得过回以前的苦日子了，不回！狗都不回！”

    傅烬川眉头紧皱，苍白的脸色只有脸颊带着耳根烫得不行。

    端着热水进门，林大柄正好撞见这暧昧的场面，尴尬地僵在原地，进也不是退也不是。

    听见动静，姜无念慢悠悠地直起身来，装作无事发生，假装替他擦拭伤口，不动声色地引导灵力帮他愈合。

    没过多久，傅烬川苍白的脸色渐渐回温，呼吸也平稳下来。

    处理完伤口，她目光在傅烬川脸上转了一圈，又看向身后的林大柄，突然有了想法。

    这不正好借花献佛，还了林大柄的一饭之恩。

    凑到林大柄身边，姜无念压低声音：“大叔，他就是你说的那个接盘老板吧？”

    林大柄看着她茫然地点了点头，“嗯，咋了？”

    “等他醒了，你就说是你救了他，像他这种身份，谢礼肯定少不了。”说着，姜无念拍了拍他的肩膀，语气轻快：“我还有点事，先出去一趟，你就在这好好看着他。”

    “哎……”林大柄下意识地想要拒绝，可话都还没说完，姜无念就已经转身出了门。

    他也想走，可傅烬川还躺在这。不出事就算了，要真出了什么事，不赔钱就算好的。他感叹一声，摇头苦笑。

    床上原本昏迷着的傅烬川，眼眸微微睁开了条缝，瞥了眼姜无念离开的背影。

    刚才他确实晕了一会，后来是被姜无念折腾醒的。

    这个疯女人，趁他受伤，一而再再而三的轻薄自己，真是可恶。

    姜无念再次来到江边，她双手拢在嘴边，朝着漆黑的江面，拉长了声音喊：

    “素仪～”

    等了一会儿，江面漾开一层冷雾，素仪披散着湿发浮了上来，周身裹着浓厚的鬼气，远远站着，不肯靠近半步。

    “你又来做什么？”她的声音飘散在四周，若有似无。
content_en:
Fu Jinchuan's Adam's apple rolled, and he regained some clarity. He hurriedly let go of his hand and tried to distance himself, but he fainted again.

    Faint?

    Afraid that something might happen to him, Jiang Wu Nian opened all his clothes and checked everywhere, touching his abdominal muscles, waist, chest muscles and hands, muttering:

    "Xiaolingdan, wake up, I promise to be gentler next time. If you die, I will have to go back to the miserable life before. No return! Not even a dog!"

    Fu Jinchuan frowned, and his pale face was so pale that only his cheeks and ears were extremely hot.

    Carrying hot water into the door, Lin Dabang happened to see this ambiguous scene and froze in place in embarrassment, neither advancing nor retreating.

    Hearing the noise, Jiang Wu Nian straightened up slowly, pretending that nothing happened, pretending to wipe his wounds, and calmly channeling his spiritual power to help him heal.

    Not long after, Fu Jinchuan's pale face gradually warmed up and his breathing calmed down.

    After treating the wound, she turned her eyes around Fu Jinchuan's face, then looked at Lin Dabang behind her, and suddenly had an idea.

    Isn't this just borrowing flowers to offer to the Buddha and repay Lin Daying's favor with a meal?

    Approaching Lin Dabing, Jiang Wunian lowered his voice: "Uncle, he is the takeover boss you mentioned, right?"

    Lin Dadian looked at her and nodded blankly, "Well, what's wrong?"

    "When he wakes up, you can say that you saved him. With someone like him, a thank you gift is indispensable." As he said that, Jiang Wu Nian patted his shoulder and said in a brisk tone, "I have something else to do. I'll go out first. You can keep a good eye on him here."

    "Hey..." Lin Dabiang subconsciously wanted to refuse, but before he could finish speaking, Jiang Wunian had already turned around and walked out the door.

    He also wanted to leave, but Fu Jinchuan was still lying here. It’s fine if nothing happens, but if something does happen, it’s fine if you don’t pay any compensation. He sighed, shook his head and smiled bitterly.

    Fu Jinchuan, who was unconscious on the bed, opened his eyes slightly and glanced at Jiang Wunian's leaving figure.

    He did faint for a while just now, but was later awakened by Jiang Wu Nian's torment.

    This crazy woman took advantage of his injury to belittle herself again and again. It was really abominable.

    Jiang Wunian came to the river again. She put her hands to her mouth and shouted towards the dark river surface in a long voice:

    "Suyi~"

    After waiting for a while, a layer of cold mist spread across the river, and Su Yi floated up with her wet hair disheveled. She was wrapped in a thick ghost aura and stood far away, refusing to come even half a step closer.

    "What are you doing here again?" Her voice floated around, as if there was nothing there.
title_en: Chapter 7: Just to meet someone, take advantage of him while he is unconscious and take advantage of him
